title: Ukrainian Yellow Pepper Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Ukraine, made with roasted yellow peppers and tender stew meat.

ingredients.name: yellow bell peppers
ingredients.notes: any color bell pepper will work, but yellow adds a sweet flavor

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: use any onion variety you like

ingredients.name: tomato paste
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality tomato paste for the best flavor

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a good quality olive oil for roasting

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: black pepper
ingredients.notes: use freshly ground black pepper for the best flavor

instructions: Cut the bell peppers in half and remove the seeds and membranes.
Place the bell peppers on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast the bell peppers in the oven for 30 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the bell peppers are roasting, chop the onion and carrots into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a large pot over medium-high heat and add the chopped onion and carrots. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped potatoes, tomato paste, chicken broth, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 20-25 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
